title: qcr --schema 3 host <verb>, host family version 1
description: What each host verb prints: one object per call, for a host that runs the reviewer for a person it has authenticated itself. The verbs are setup, review-now, proof-start, proof-result and go-live. Each is non-interactive and answers within seconds; long work is started detached and followed through the board export (schemas/board.v1.json: `setup`, `go_live`, `proof`). `state` is one of the verb's closed set, and a refusal or failure carries a closed `reason`: a host maps both to its own text. The exit code is 0 when the verb did what it was asked or says what is already under way, 2 for a call it could not read (reason usage), 1 for any other refusal or failure; the object is printed in each case. No field carries a URL or a credential.

reason.description: Why a verb refused, or why a practice round failed. Present with state refused or failed.

holder.description: What holds the setup lock, with state busy: the reviewer's own terminal home, or a host verb's work (setup, go_live, proof).

state.description: started: the config is written and the setup walk runs, detached; the board export's `setup` field follows it. running: a setup walk is already under way, and nothing new was started. busy: something else holds the setup lock (holder). refused: nothing was started (reason).

message.description: The refusal or failure in words, for a log. A host shows its own text for `reason`.

state.description: queued: the daemon queued the pull request. sent: the request is written and the daemon has not answered yet; the board export's `reviewing` list shows the pull request once it has. refused: nothing was asked (reason).

message.description: The refusal or failure in words, for a log. A host shows its own text for `reason`.

pr.description: The pull request the call named.

state.description: started: the daemon queued the practice round. sent: the request is written and the daemon has not answered yet. running: a round of that pull request is already under way, and it is the practice round. busy: something else holds the setup lock (holder). refused: nothing was asked (reason).

message.description: The refusal or failure in words, for a log. A host shows its own text for `reason`.

pr.description: The pull request the call named.

state.description: running: the practice round has not finished. done: it has; `proof` is the record a go-live is confirmed against and `review` is the review as it would have been posted. Returning this is what marks the practice review as shown. failed: the round produced no practice review (reason). not_started: no practice round was asked for on that pull request. busy: something else holds the setup lock (holder). refused: nothing was read (reason).

message.description: The refusal or failure in words, for a log. A host shows its own text for `reason`.

pr.description: The pull request the call named.

state.description: started: the attestation was admitted and the go-live runs, detached; the board export's `go_live` field follows it, and `posting` says when the daemon posts. running: a go-live is already under way. busy: something else holds the setup lock (holder). refused: nothing was changed (reason).

message.description: The refusal or failure in words, for a log. A host shows its own text for `reason`.

verdict.description: The round's verdict on the merits.

completed_at.description: When the practice review was recorded, ISO.

proof.description: The practice round, with state done. A go-live attestation names its `pr` and `round_no`.

event.description: The review event GitHub would have been sent. Absent when the record names none of the three.

body.description: The review body, cut at 20000 characters.

comments.description: The inline comments in the review's order, the first 50 at most.

comments_total.description: How many inline comments the review holds, those past the first 50 included.

review.description: The review as it would have been posted, read out of the dry-run record: plain text, to be shown as plain text.

line.description: The line the comment anchors to; 0 when the record names none.
